server.description: Search newly registered, expired, aged, active, deleted and for-sale domains, plus WHOIS and DNS.

serverInfo.description: DomainKits MCP exposes factual domain registration, DNS, availability, trend, market, and user-state data. Fields and source coverage may be incomplete. The server does not execute Skill workflows or provide investment conclusions. Concurrent tool calls are not supported: parallel calls are rejected and return no data. Call tools one at a time and wait for each result before sending the next. When a result says limit_reached, stop calling that tool, show the user its message and links, and do not work around it with other tools.
